status: Pinned CPU source and remote public-audio inference qualified; not installed, published or connected to a microphone

whisper_rs.cancellation_review: set_abort_callback_safe erases F into a boxed trait object then its trampoline casts the userdata back to F; ownership is not retained. Do not call this helper.

whisper_rs_sys.build_review: Only unchanged MIT C++ source from this exact archive is carried. Neither the Rust sys binding nor its build script is adopted. Dedicated CMake and six-parameter bridge control the CPU floor and own-process cancellation.

release_gates: Retain the full MIT copyright and licence notices before redistributing converted weights.
Extend the existing protected U2-Net-only release job after review; do not create a trust key.
Publish exact receipt-checked weights/licence and deliver the reviewed signed catalogue through the normal image lifecycle.
Audit the engine ABI, portable x86-64/Arm64 baseline, bounded cancellation and process isolation; benchmark before choosing a default.

engine.sandbox: full Landlock and shared parser seccomp before native loading

qualification.command: On the build machine, use any cargo drop-in: run --locked -p local-model-service --example speech_qualify
limits: Builder timings do not establish older-device performance.
Non-English quality and microphone latency are unmeasured.

The installed CLI correctly refuses elevated developer overrides. Its positive --worker fixture journey still needs an unprivileged runtime; --worker-core validates the same production handler and process limits in an uninstalled qualification child.
